scope: Four saved deterministic discovery responses before and after v0.2 changes. Each side retains query interpretation, constraints, counts, pagination when reported, and the first six exact font IDs with family, style, heuristic score and reasons. No font binaries or full family-style inventories are included.
limitations: This is a deterministic baseline comparison, not a learned visual-model outcome or a held-out evaluation.
The after responses explicitly report visual_scoring_active=false; the before implementation disclaims embedding or image similarity.
Catalog size changes from 27,454 to 27,520 faces. Implementation, collection and context-preference differences mean rank changes do not isolate one change or prove improved design quality.
The before response did not expose pagination; null means unreported, not no further candidates.
Original saved responses are preserved outside the public source/evidence bundle. Input briefs are not reconstructed from the response objects.

query_interpretation.name_lookup_advice: query ranks preferences and can return alternatives when a name is absent. Use family for a hard exact family-name lookup.
query_interpretation.method: Small explicit aliases, metadata name matches, measured properties. Unmodeled terms affect only literal name matches; unrecognized brief fields have no effect. No embedding or image-based similarity is claimed.

constraints.coverage: Requested non-layout characters must occur in cmap; this does not prove shaping correctness.
constraints.family_diversity: At most one face per family; equivalent canonical content is also deduplicated. Equal-score ties favor differences in known category, width, monospace measurement, x-height, and advance-width bands; this is not proof of visual distinction.
